verdict.rationale: MoonPay is a crypto payments and ramp platform, so agent-initiated stablecoin payments under spend controls is a fair question for it. The evidence shows no such capability. Its only agent-facing feature is an MCP server for searching and retrieving documentation. Forwarding a customer's access token to call the API server-side, quote limits, and stablecoin enterprise rails are developer building blocks or adjacent features. None of them is a documented agent payment flow with human-configured scoped spend authority.
